CPU_scope: Sum of per-stage kernel wait4 child/subreaper usage; guard supervisors and outer controller excluded. No new CPU hard cap.
RSS_scope: Sampled unique-PID conservative sum of target descendants plus active guard; outer controller excluded. Shared pages across distinct PIDs may be double-counted; between-sample peaks not guaranteed.
documentation_preservation: All documents/indexes bound by the source manifest remain byte-identical; new result report/note/manifest provide this attempt status without modifying frozen files.
output_scope: Peak sampled bytes across new private/result/source/review roots, inode-deduplicated; includes source seed bytes, excludes read-only prior/runtime/frozen inputs. Evidence packaging after STOP is outside execution runtime measurement.
scope: Read-only equality, saved-status/counter, hash, process identity and resource-record audit only. No audit/LP/echo/verifier rerun or mathematical re-evaluation.
